name: Patrick Esser

affiliations.role: Research assistant; co-author of Taming Transformers and latent diffusion

bio: Patrick Esser is a co-founder of Black Forest Labs. They previously worked on generative models at LMU Munich and later at Runway, and are an author of Taming Transformers (VQGAN) and the latent diffusion paper.
